raw_output:
Giver: Hi, can you hear me?
Follower: Yes, I can hear you. Where should I start?
Giver: Start at the cross on your map.
Follower: Okay, I'm at the cross. What do I do next?
Giver: Move up a bit, then left. Go past the diamond mine on your left.
Follower: The diamond mine? Oh, I see it. So I go left of that?
Giver: No, wait. You're going the wrong way. Go up first, then turn left. You'll pass the mine on your left side.
Follower: Ah, okay. Up, then left. Right, past the mine.
Giver: Good. Now keep going left until you hit the graveyard.
Follower: I don't see a graveyard on my map. Do you have a different one?
Giver: What? I have a graveyard right there next to the river. Why don't you?
Follower: Maybe it's just not on my map. Okay, I'll ignore it for now. I'm going left past the river.
Giver: Wait, you're going too far left! The river is on the right, not the left. Turn back right.
Follower: Oh, I see. So the river is on my right. Okay, I'm turning right now.
Giver: Good. Now go up past the river, then turn left. You should see an Apache camp on your left soon.
Follower: Apache camp? Yeah, I see it. But it's pretty far up. Is that the one?
Giver: Yes, that's the one. Make sure you go left of the camp.
Follower: Okay, I'm going left of the camp now.
Giver: Good. Now keep going up and left. You'll reach a carved wooden pole on your right.
Follower: Carved wooden pole? I see one on my right. Okay, I'll go past it.
Giver: Wait, which pole? There are two poles on the whole map. One near the top, one near the bottom. Which one did you mean?
Follower: Oh, I thought you meant the one near the top. That's the first one I saw.
Giver: No, I meant the second one, the lower one. The one near the walled city. I'm going to go down to the walled city now.
Follower: Oh, I'm still near the top pole. I didn't know there was another one. Okay, I'll head down to the walled city.
Giver: Okay, go down to the walled city on your left.
Follower: Found it. It's on my left. Okay, going up past it now.
Giver: Good. Now go right, past some flat rocks on your left.
Follower: Flat rocks? I see rocks on my left. Are those the flat rocks?
Giver: Yes, those are the flat rocks. Go right past them.
Follower: Okay, I'm going right now.
Giver: Good. Now go up and right. You'll see a buffalo on your right soon.
Follower: Buffalo? I don't see any animals on my map. What do you mean?
Giver: A buffalo. It's a big animal. It's on the right side of the map, near the middle.
Follower: Oh, I think I see a symbol that might be an animal. Is that it?
Giver: Yes, that's it. Go right past the buffalo.
Follower: Okay, I'm going right of the buffalo now.
Giver: Good. Now go up and left. You'll see a cattle ranch on your left.
Follower: Cattle ranch? I don't see a ranch. Is that the same as the Apache camp?
Giver: No, it's different. The Apache camp is higher up. The ranch is lower down, near the fort.
Follower: Oh, I see. There's a ranch lower down. Okay, going left of the ranch now.
Giver: Good. Now go up and right. You'll see a fort on your right.
Follower: Fort? I see a building on my right. Is that the fort?
Giver: Yes, that's the fort. Go right past it.
Follower: Okay, I'm going right of the fort now.
Giver: Good. Now go down and left. You'll reach the finish line.
Follower: Finish? I don't see a finish line. Just buildings and stuff.
Giver: The finish is at the bottom left. It's marked with a cross. Look for the cross.
Follower: Oh! There it is. I see a cross at the bottom left.
Giver: Great. Now draw a line from the fort to that cross.
Follower: Okay, drawing the line... almost there.
Giver: Is that the finish?
Follower: Yes, I think so. I'm at the cross.
Giver: Perfect. You did it.
Follower: Okay, done.
